exposure: interaction with staff in the delivery suite
cohort: 490 women who gave birth during the COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan
finding: While COVID-19 infection during pregnancy did not significantly affect women's childbirth experience, pandemic-related factors like hospital type, mode of delivery, and staff interaction did, with positive staff interactions leading to a more positive experience and a higher likelihood of low mood post-delivery, particularly in first-time mothers.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery during the COVID-19 pandemic was a factor that affected the childbirth experience.
